b'# tinydl

A simple command-line downloader.

## CLI Usage

The `tinydl` command-line interface allows you to download content from a URL.

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `url`     | What to download |

### Options

| Option | Short | Description |
|---------|-------|-------------|
| `--output` | `-o` | File to write (default: stdout) |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | No progress output |
'
